meta.title: Related Rates 2 V1
meta.prompt: The slots on the right describe various geometric objects that are changing in different ways, and ask for the rate at which a particular quantity is changing. Match the cards on the right that describe the correct quantity to the slot for which that quantity is a solution. Directions: Drag one or more \(\text{cards}\), on the left, onto a single \(\text{slot}\), on the right. It is possible that some \(\text{cards}\) may not be used. \(\small\text{Cards}\) \(\small\text{Slots}\)

zone_labels.drop1: The radius of a circle of \(r\text{ cm}\) is increasing at a rate of \(a\text{ cm/s}\). At what rate is the circumference growing?
zone_labels.drop2: The edge of a square is \(s\text{ cm}\), and increasing at a rate of \(a \text{ cm/s}\). At what rate is the area of the square growing?
zone_labels.drop3: The width of a rectangle is \(w \text{ cm}\) and the height is \(h \text{ cm}\). The width is decreasing at a rate of \(b \text{ cm/s}\) while the height remains constant. At what rate is the perimeter of the rectangle decreasing?
zone_labels.drop4: The radius of a circle is \(r\text{ cm}\), and is increasing at a rate of \(a \text{ cm/s}\). At what rate is the diameter growing?
